about: Every page that turns a placement into points reads this file. Edit a table here when Epic changes the rules; no code changes needed. 'active' picks the scheme; FN_SCORING or SCORING in .env overrides it. Check each table against the official rules attachment before relying on it.

fncs_2026_duos_finals.label: FNCS 2026 Duos, online finals
fncs_2026_duos_finals.source: FNCS 2026 official rules, scoring attachment: 65 for a win down to 2 for 25th, 0 below; 4 per elimination.

fncs_2026_global_championship.label: FNCS 2026 Global Championship (assumed)
fncs_2026_global_championship.source: Epic's rules don't publish a Global Championship table; assumed to match the online finals. Replace it if Epic publishes one.

fncs_2026_solos_finals.label: FNCS 2026 Solos, finals
fncs_2026_solos_finals.source: FNCS 2026 Solos official rules: 60 for a win, then 53, 49, 47, 46 and 1 less per place down to 2 for 49th; 4 per elimination in finals.

fncs_2026_solos_qualifiers.label: FNCS 2026 Solos, qualifiers
fncs_2026_solos_qualifiers.source: FNCS 2026 Solos official rules: same placement table as finals; 2 per elimination in qualifiers.
